summary: COMPASS Pathways plc filed an 8-K to disclose an investor presentation (Item 7.01) and Phase 3 trial results for COMP360 psilocybin in treatment-resistant depression (Item 8.01). No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or activist event is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical data and an investor deck, not a special situation. The registrant is a pharmaceutical issuer reporting business updates with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes.
